in_process.registration: ISiloBuilder.AddLatticeReplicationApi after AddLatticeReplication(..., enableRuntimeConfig: true); ISiloBuilder.AddLatticeReplicationStatusApi after AddLatticeReplication(...).

grpc.marshalling: API facade methods use LatticeReplicationGrpcMarshallers; peer replication methods use Orleans serializer-backed code-first marshallers and the replication batch encoder for WAL envelopes.

metadata.name: authorization
metadata.purpose: Credential token header; the default bridge strips the configured ****** and stamps a LatticeCredential.

metadata.name: active tenant header
metadata.purpose: Configured active tenant assertion header; the assertion is re-validated downstream and grants no access by itself.

metadata.name: x-lattice-replication-secret
metadata.purpose: Shared-secret credential attached to every peer replication gRPC call and validated by the receiver interceptor.

metadata.name: x-lattice-replication-origin
metadata.purpose: Local cluster id stamped on peer calls for diagnostics, peer attribution, saga authorization, origin/body consistency checks, and credential-to-origin binding (on by default, disabled with BindCredentialToOriginCluster false).

auth.authorizer: IReplicationSecretProvider for peer transports; ILatticeReplicationApiAuthorizer for the facade and status facade; ISagaPeerAuthorizer for saga control after shared-secret auth.
auth.decision: Peer replication methods require the shared-secret header when RequireAuthentication is true; missing credentials are Unauthenticated and bad credentials are PermissionDenied. With BindCredentialToOriginCluster at its default true, an accepted credential must also match the outbound secret configured for the stamped origin or the call is PermissionDenied. The facade authorizer covers the control service and peer-status service, exempts only GetAuthScheme, and maps GetPeerStatus to LatticeReplicationApiOperation.GetPeerStatus. Saga control additionally denies origins outside the configured peer map before state mutation.
